title: ursinia versicolor
intro: Ursinia versicolor, commonly known as the Hottentot daisy or Yellow daisy, is a flowering plant native to the Western Cape province of South Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. Ursinia versicolor has been traditionally used to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits, including antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
